Daret

Your Daret, without the notebook

Add your group once. VVollet takes your share out on the day it’s due and knows which months the pot is coming to you. Money you’ve promised the group stays clearly visible alongside the rest of your finances.

Shares
Hold one or several shares in the same group
Payment day
Any day from the 1st to the 28th
Paid from
A bank account or the cash in your pocket
Payout goes to
The account you choose

What it tracks

The rest of your money, in the same place

  1. Cash and bank, side by side

    Count the notes in your wallet as seriously as your bank balance. Withdrawals move money between the two.

  2. Bills and subscriptions

    Rent, internet, phone, streaming. The next ones due show up on your home screen before they leave.

  3. Budgets by category

    Set a limit for food or transport and see how much of it is gone, part-way through the month.

  4. Savings goals

    A car, a wedding, a cushion for bad months. Each deposit moves the goal forward.

  5. Debts and money lent

    Bank loans on one side; what you lent a friend, and what a friend lent you, on the other.

  6. Net worth

    See everything you own, minus everything you owe, from your accounts, cash, goals and debts.

Coming next

What we’re building now

These are in development and not in the first release. We’ll add them in updates, and this page will say when each one is ready.

  • In development

    A coach you can ask about your money

    Ask in your own words, like “can I afford this?” or “where did my money go this month?”. The Coach answers from your accounts, budgets, bills, goals and debts. It can log an expense, a transfer, a goal deposit, a subscription or a debt payment for you, and nothing changes until you tap Confirm. You can also send it a photo, such as a receipt.

  • In development

    Talk to the Coach

    Ask out loud instead of typing. Anything you ask it to change by voice still waits for your confirmation on screen.

  • In development

    Reminders and alerts

    A heads-up before a bill is due, an alert when a budget is running out, an optional daily summary and weekly report, and a notice for any transaction above an amount you choose. Quiet hours keep them away at night.

  • In development

    Investments

    Add your stock positions with current prices, and follow your portfolio alongside the rest of your money.

The Coach will ask your permission before it reads anything. How the Coach will handle your data

Privacy

Your numbers are nobody else’s business

  • Only your account can read them

    Your data syncs to your VVollet account. Database rules make sure each record can only be read by the person who created it.

  • A PIN on the app

    Lock VVollet with a PIN, and hide your balances from the app switcher when you leave the app.

  • Photos without the extras

    Location and camera details are removed from photos before they are saved.
